interpretation: A small box relative to publisher truth is not proof of a bad partial mask. Representative isolated animals at2877/2895 have near-complete visible masks yet low rectangle IoU due loose publisher extent. No obvious sustained identity misbinding is established by these selected stills. This does not remove any strict error or prove >99% naming quality.
next_step_proposal: Before another mask model or geometry transform, independently annotate a frozen balanced sample from clean images without predictions, including correctly scored and failed cases, using an explicit whole-visible-body rule. Keep current publisher scores and separately report any manual-diagnostic findings; do not repair only failures. Mask refinement is justified only if this review identifies omitted visible anatomy rather than mere label-shape mismatch. No model run proposed yet.
publisher_method: Video labels originated from a fine-tuned YOLOv8m plus ByteTrack and manual tracking/error corrections. The paper discloses missing boxes and detector bias; it does not specify these labels as consistent manually drawn modal or amodal masks.
